title: Corbell's private source on the existence of the S-4 facility
summary: Jeremy Corbell tells of Corbell's private source on the existence of the S-4 facility, about before meeting Lazar at S-4, Nevada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And what that is is why I knew that Bob Lazar was telling it as it is, meaning a facility like that exists.

plain: Jeremy Corbell, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, talks about Bob Lazar, a man who has said he worked on alien craft at a secret site called S-4 in the Nevada desert. Corbell says that a private source of his had already told him that a facility like S-4 exists, and that this is why he believed Lazar was telling it as it is. If so, it would back up one of the best-known claims of a hidden base for studying non-human craft.
